description: Analyse a user-supplied aged-debtors CSV and supplied Bank Rate to return review-only UK B2B chase wording with indicative statutory-interest and fixed-compensation calculations. Returns draft text and structured calculations without storing the CSV or sending messages.

as_of_date.description: Date to calculate overdue days and interest as at; omit to use today in UTC.

bank_rate_percent.description: Bank Rate percentage to use for this indicative calculation. SHVL adds the statutory 8 percentage points.

csv_text.description: User-supplied aged-debtors export with customer, invoice number, due date and outstanding amount columns. Supports at most 50 invoice rows; split larger exports before calling.

draft_stage.description: Tone for the review-only reminder: gentle, formal or final. Omit to use formal wording.

sender_name.description: Business or sign-off name used in the review-only draft.

name: analyse_aged_debtors_csv

outputSchema.description: Review-only calculation: summary totals and each draft show overdue principal, indicative statutory interest, compensation and total claim in GBP pence. drafts contains suggested subject and body; not_overdue_invoices lists excluded invoices. as_of_date and annual_rate_percent identify calculation assumptions. Nothing is stored or sent.

title: Analyse an aged-debtors CSV
